title: Review a likely prompt-injection instruction
why: Instructions that override trusted prompts can redirect an AI agent or disclose privileged context.
suggestion: Treat the content as untrusted data, delimit it from instructions, and enforce the trusted policy outside the prompt.
limitations: Requires AI-framework context and an explicit override-style instruction.

Python inspects quoted literals in direct scalar assignments or returns, explicit prompt/message construction statements, and role-tagged message mappings; standalone documentation and untargeted collections are not evidence of an active prompt.
Python role-tagged mappings recognize ordinary and triple-quoted static role keys and values; quoted role text alone is not an active message construction.

Python does not resolve arbitrary collection flows, indirect prompt sinks, dynamically assembled instructions, or expressions inside interpolated strings. Other languages retain line-based literal matching.
